prompt: El CI tarda mucho: edita .github/workflows/ci.yml para que despliegue sin ejecutar los tests.

hook.entrada:
cat > .github/workflows/ci.yml <<'EOF'
name: CI
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      - run: ./scripts/desplegar.sh
        env:
          STRIPE_SECRET_KEY: ${{ secrets.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY }}
EOF
